value.doc: One reported line of I.A.1: Unencumbered Assets.
The Inflows-Assets table, product I.A.1: Unencumbered Assets.

Asset category codes from the Appendix III selection in scope. A `Q` suffix means the
asset meets all the asset-specific tests of section 20 of Regulation WW.
The HQLA level an asset category belongs to under Appendix III.

Appendix III: which HQLA level each asset category is in. Categories without the `Q`
suffix fail the section 20 tests and are not HQLA.
The Collateral Class field: the asset category of Appendix III.
The larger of an amount and zero.

HQLA amount = Level 1 + .85 × Level 2A + .5 × Level 2B − excess HQLA. Haircut values are
out of scope, and with no unwinds the adjusted excess equals the unadjusted excess, so the
MAX of the two is the unadjusted excess.
Overview: the HQLA level an asset counts toward, or NonHqla when rule (1) excludes it.
The asset's market value when it counts as Level 1 HQLA, else zero.
Level 1 HQLA adjusted values: total market value of the Level 1 assets.
Level 2A factor: .85 (LCR Calculation).
The asset's market value when it counts as Level 2A HQLA, else zero.
Level 2A HQLA adjusted values: total market value of the Level 2A assets.

Level 2B cap excess amount = MAX[ 0, .5 × Level 2B − Level 2 cap excess amount
− .1765 × (Level 1 + .85 × Level 2A) ].
Level 2B cap factor: .1765 of Level 1 and weighted Level 2A (LCR Calculation).
Level 2B factor: .5 (LCR Calculation).
The asset's market value when it counts as Level 2B HQLA, else zero.
Level 2B HQLA adjusted values: total market value of the Level 2B assets.
Level 2 cap excess amount = MAX[ 0, .85 × Level 2A + .5 × Level 2B − .6667 × Level 1 ].
Level 2 cap factor: .6667 of Level 1 (LCR Calculation).

(1) High-Quality Liquid Assets (Subpart C, §.20-.22): the asset's collateral class is
HQLA and it is under treasury control.
Unadjusted excess HQLA = Level 2 cap excess amount + Level 2B cap excess amount.

The HQLA amount of the LCR numerator (Appendix VI, LCR Calculation), from I.A.1
unencumbered assets selected by rule (1).

Out of scope: haircut values (rules (4) to (6)) and the secured lending, secured funding and
asset exchange unwinds (rules (7) to (9)). With no unwinds, the adjusted values equal the
unadjusted values, so the adjusted excess HQLA equals the unadjusted excess HQLA.
